title: If the Sun Vanished, You Wouldn't Know for 8 Minutes
lines: What if the Sun suddenly became a black hole?
For {8 minutes and 20 seconds~eight minutes and twenty seconds}, | nothing would change.
That's how long sunlight takes to reach us, | and gravity is no faster.
And then, | the sky would go dark.
But Earth would keep the same orbit. | Only mass and distance matter.
So how small is a black {hole/~hole} with the Sun's mass?
About {6 kilometers~six kilometers} wide. | Smaller than a city.
Back on Earth, | within weeks the land could drop below {−18 °C~minus eighteen degrees}.
But here's the twist: | the Sun can never do this.
It's far too light. | It would need to be about {20 times~twenty times} heavier.
Crush Earth {into/~into} a black hole instead. | How big would it be? | About the size of a marble, | or about the size of a car? | Tell me in the comments.

preroll.line: Crush the whole {Sun/~Sun} into a black hole, | and it would be just {6 kilometers~six kilometers} wide.
